EmailTemplate.subject: Calling all travelers, are you ready for your next adventure!?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi Traveler,
We are so excited that you have an interest in traveling! Elite365 has opportunities that will allow your passion and career to collide. We have a variety of opportunities that you qualify for. We promise to provide top-notch customer service and to be by your side along the way!
We offer competitive pay packages, benefits you deserve, and we have a team that is excited to meet you. I would like the opportunity to speak with you in regards to your needs for your next travel assignment. In the meantime, here are a few "wins" we provide: Medical, Dental, Vision and 401K available on Day 1 Assistance with housing Referral program with unlimited earning potential for referring qualified Allied Healthcare Professionals our way $250 License Allowance for Each State You Accept an Assignment
Please let me know when it is a good time and a good number to reach you. I can't wait to hear from you!
